name: Executive Summary Q3
prompt: "I need a high-level executive summary for Q3 company performance. Give me a clean, simple layout with massive KPI cards for Total Revenue, Profit Margin, and Customer Acquisition Cost. Below that, just show one beautifully simple line chart tracking our growth against our Q3 target, and a small data table of our 3 biggest closing deals."

thought_process.interpretation: The user is an executive looking for a high-level strategic overview of Q3 performance. I have selected the 'Executive Summary' grid layout, focusing on three primary KPI metrics (Revenue, Profit, CAC) followed by a comparative growth trend analysis and a focused deal audit.
thought_process.skill_suggestions: A dedicated 'Financial Metric Formatting' utility skill would help standardize currency and percentage display across all components.
